depends_on: generalized Pell equations: finitely many solution classes
notes: 'Recurrence of order m' is undefined: the m = 5 example splits mod 4 and Barker's g.f. has degree-9 denominator. Precise version true: m n^2 = n + floor(sqrt(m) n floor(sqrt(m) n)) iff (mn-1)^2 - m k^2 in {1-m, 1-2m}, k = floor(sqrt(m) n), so solutions are finitely many Pell orbits, periodically interleaved, rational g.f.; interleaving periods 1,1,4,2,1,1,2,2 for m = 2,3,5,6,7,8,10,11 (not m). pell.py: reduction for m < 40, n < 2e5; m = 5 orbits give the 23 data terms. Outside Lean: all (reduction + Pell class finiteness).
